steps.title: Amplify Probe Template via PCR
steps.instruction: Perform 5+ PCR reactions using pGEM-T easy with the probe inserted as a template, using OneTaq DNA Polymerase and T7 and Sp6 primers.

substeps.instruction: Set annealing temperature to 40.5°C.
Set extension time appropriate for probe length (typically ~30 seconds).

steps.title: Perform In Vitro Transcription
steps.instruction: Perform 3 in vitro transcription reactions using either T7 or Sp6 polymerase (based on anti-sense orientation of probe in pGEM-T Easy).

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction with: 2 μL 10x Transcription Buffer, 2 μL 10x DIG, 0.5 μL Protector RNase Inhibitor, 1 μL Sp6 or T7 RNA polymerase, 500ng template, and Ultrapure H2O to a final volume of 20 μL.
Incubate at 37°C for 2 hours.
Ensure all surfaces and pipettes are treated with RNase Zap and use RNase-free reagents.

steps.title: Prepare RNase-Free Gel
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2% agarose gel in an RNase-free environment.

substeps.instruction: Spray the gel mold and electrophoresis box thoroughly with RNase Zap and wash with MilliQ water.
RNase Zap and rinse the interior of a bottle with MilliQ water before preparing the 2% agarose gel.

steps.title: Purify RNA using RNeasy Mini Column
steps.instruction: Purify the transcription product using a RNeasy Mini spin column.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μL RLT buffer and mix well.
Add 250 μL 100% ethanol and mix well by pipetting; proceed immediately to the next step.
Transfer 700 μL to a RNeasy Mini spin column in a 2 mL collection tube; centrifuge for 15s at 10,000 rpm (8,000g) and discard flow-through.
Add 350 μL Buffer RW1; centrifuge for 15s at 10,000 rpm.
Combine 10 μL DNase I stock solution and 70 μL Buffer RDD; mix gently by inverting.
Add 80 μL of the DNase I/Buffer RDD solution directly to the column membrane and incubate on the bench for 15 min at room temperature.
Add 350 μL Buffer RW1; centrifuge for 15s at 10,000 rpm and discard flow-through.
Add 500 μL Buffer RPE; centrifuge for 15s at 10,000 rpm and discard flow-through.
Add another 500 μL Buffer RPE; centrifuge for 2 min at 10,000 rpm and discard flow-through.
Place column into a new 2 mL collection tube; centrifuge at max speed for 1 min.
Place column into a 1.5 mL collection tube and add 50 μL Ultrapure H2O directly to the membrane; centrifuge for 1 min at 10,000 rpm.
Remove eluate and re-apply to the column for a second wash.

steps.title: Verify RNA Quality
steps.instruction: Confirm the size and quality of the RNA product.

substeps.instruction: Remove 2 μL of eluate for analysis; store the remainder at -80°C.
Add 8 μL of Ultrapure H2O to the 2 μL sample and incubate at 60°C for 10 minutes.
Add a clear loading dye (e.g., 40% sucrose) and run on the 2% RNase-free agarose gel.
Prepare an oven at 65°C.
Air-dry slides at room temperature for 15-20 min.
Re-hydrate tissue by rinsing in ~3 mL of 1X DEPC PBS.
Fix tissues in 4% PFA (prepared in 1X DEPC PBS) for 1-2 hr at room temperature or overnight at 4°C with gentle rocking.
Wash in 1X DEPC PBS by gently rocking for 30 min.
Transfer tissue through a sucrose series in 1X DEPC PBS: 5%, 10%, 20%, and 30%. Move to the next concentration when tissue sinks, or rock overnight in 30% at 4°C.
Add an approximately equal volume of OCT compound to the 30% sucrose/1X DEPC PBS and equilibrate on a gentle inversion rocker for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Freeze and Store Tissue
steps.instruction: Embed and freeze the tissue for sectioning.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a dry-ice/ethanol bath and RNase Zap forceps.
Remove tissue from 30% sucrose/OCT solution and place into a tissue mold; fill mold with OCT and orient tissue.
Place mold into the dry-ice/ethanol bath to freeze OCT.
Move frozen tissue into plastic bags and store at -80°C until sectioning.

steps.title: Prepare Slides for Hybridization
steps.instruction: Process sections and prepare for probe application.

substeps.instruction: Air-dry sections for 30 min to 2 hrs (or store at -80°C).
Fix slides in 4% PFA DEPC 1X PBS for 10 min.
Rinse in DEPC PBT, then wash twice in DEPC PBT for 5 min each, and rinse once more in DEPC PBT.
Post-fix with 4% PFA 1X DEPC PBS for 5 min.
Rinse in DEPC PBT, wash twice in DEPC PBT for 5 min each, and rinse in DEPC H2O.

steps.title: Perform Hybridization
steps.instruction: Apply the probe and incubate slides.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a humidified slide box: place a cylinder of paper towels soaked in ~25 mL of 5X SSC/50% formamide at the bottom of a slide box stood on its end.
For each slide: gently wick water off with a Kimwipe, wipe edges to create a dry border, and apply 150 μL of probe/hybridization buffer (mix 3 μL probe with 147 μL buffer).
Apply a coverslip-sized piece of polyethylene plastic bag material to each slide and place in the humidified box.
Seal the box edges with plastic tape, ensuring slides do not tip.
Incubate the box upright in the 65°C oven overnight.

steps.title: Post-Hybridization Stringency Washes
steps.instruction: Wash slides using plastic staining dishes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer slides to 1X SSC/50% formamide for 30 min at 65°C.
Incubate in TNE for 10 min at 37°C.
Incubate in TNE again for 10 min at 37°C (reuse TNE).
Incubate in 2X SSC for 20 min at 65°C.
Incubate in 0.2X SSC for 20 min at 65°C.
Incubate in 0.2X SSC for another 20 min at 65°C.

steps.title: Blocking and Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Block non-specific binding and incubate with anti-DIG antibody.

substeps.instruction: Wash slides twice in MABT for 5 min each at room temperature.
Prepare blocking solution: dissolve 2% (w/v) blocking reagent in MABT, then add 20% sheep serum. Incubate in a 55°C water bath with intermittent shaking.
Move slides to a staining tray and add 1 mL of block per slide; incubate for a minimum of 1 hour.
Incubate in a-DIG-AP (1:2000) diluted in 20% HISS/2% blocking reagent in MABT (1 mL/slide) overnight at 4°C in a humidified chamber.

steps.title: Final Washes and Mounting
steps.instruction: Wash slides and mount for imaging.

substeps.instruction: Rinse once in MABT, then wash three times for 5 min each in MABT at room temperature.
Wash in NTM pH 9.5 for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash in NTM pH 9.5 for 5 min.
Wash in PBS for 5 min.
Fix in 4% PFA/PBS for 30 min.
Wash with 1X PBS, 1X PBS, and water (5 min each).
Slightly dry each slide; while still wet, apply mounting media (warmed to 65°C) and a coverslip, avoiding bubbles.
Cure slides in a dry place overnight.
